_comment: Story-so-far recaps (gamecmn story_*.bxon), fan translation, 5 lines max.

tm.大切な儀式を控えた {var:1}は\n少女とともに とある岩山を目指し歩きだす:
With an important rite of passage ahead,
{var:1} sets off with a young girl
towards a rocky peak. Its sheer cliffs tower
high and treacherous, as if to test the pair.
tm.１６歳の誕生日を迎えた者が 神の岩に登り\n大地の精霊に 祈りを捧げる……。\n:
Those who turn sixteen must climb
Cobblestone Tor and pray to the Spirit of
the Land... Born on the same day,
{var:1} and childhood friend Gemma are
to face the rite together.
tm.道中で 襲いかかってきた魔物を倒した\n{var:1}は 神の岩の頂上を目指し\:
Having fought off the monsters that
attacked on the way, {var:1} presses on
towards the summit of the Tor...
tm.頂上に たどり着いた ふたりは\n魔物の襲撃に あったものの\n突然の 落雷に助:
Reaching the summit, the pair are attacked
by a monster, but a sudden bolt of lightning
saves them.
tm.大地の精霊に 祈りを捧げ\n無事に イシの村へ戻った ふたりは\n神の岩の頂上で:
Having prayed to the Spirit of the Land and
returned safely to Cobblestone, the pair tell
Chief Dunstan what happened at the
summit.
tm.それを聞いた ダンは {var:1}とエマに\nロトゼタシアの広大さを 伝えると:
Dunstan reveals the true meaning of the
rite: to show {var:1} and Gemma how
vast Erdrea is. The pair then go to tell
{var:1}'s mother Amber that the rite is
complete.
tm.大地の精霊に 祈りを捧げ\n無事に イシの村へ戻った ふたりは\n神の岩で ふた:
Having prayed to the Spirit of the Land and
returned safely to Cobblestone, the pair tell
Amber about the strange lightning that
saved them on the Tor.
tm.それを聞いた ペルラは {var:1}に\nお前は 勇者の生まれ変わりだと\n今:
Hearing this, Amber reveals the truth she
has hidden all along: {var:1} is the
Luminary reborn. Stunned by the news,
{var:1} spends a sleepless night...
tm.自分は 勇者の生まれ変わりである……。\n成人の儀式を終えた {var:1}が:
"I am the Luminary reborn..." This was the
astonishing truth {var:1} heard from
Amber after the coming-of-age rite.
tm.その使命を果たすため 村を出ることになり\n眠れぬ夜を過ごしていた {var:1:
Unable to sleep before leaving to fulfil this
destiny, {var:1} hears the legend of the
Luminary's star from Gemma beneath their
tree, then wakes to the morning of
departure...
tm.その使命を 果たすため\n村を 出ることになった {var:1}は\n村中の人々:
To fulfil this destiny, {var:1} leaves the
village, seen off by everyone, and heads for
the kingdom of Heliodor to the north...
tm.その使命を 果たすため\n村を出た {var:1}は\n北にある デルカダール王:
Leaving the village to fulfil this destiny,
{var:1} reaches the kingdom of Heliodor
to the north and enters Heliodor Castle to
meet the King.
tm.自分は 勇者の生まれ変わりである。\nその事実を知った {var:1}は\n自ら:
Learning of being the Luminary reborn,
{var:1} leaves Cobblestone to fulfil that
destiny and arrives in the kingdom of
Heliodor to the north.
tm.ついに デルカダール王との謁見がかなったが\n王は {var:1}の素性を知ると:
At last {var:1} meets the King, who,
learning who {var:1} is, declares the
Luminary an enemy of the land. {var:1}
is seized by General Hendrik and thrown
into the dungeon...
tm.無事 王との謁見を果たした {var:1}だったが\n勇者こそ この大地に あだ:
{var:1} meets the King, only to be
branded the Darkspawn, a bringer of
disaster, and thrown in jail. Then, in the
gloomy dungeon, a mysterious hooded
youth appears before {var:1}.
tm.謎の青年は 見張りの兵士から 奪ったカギで\n{var:1}を 牢から出すと\n:
The mysterious youth frees {var:1} with
a key stolen from a guard, and says to
come and find him...
tm.謎の青年の助けにより\n牢を出て 荷物を取り返した {var:1}は\n青年とと:
With the mysterious youth's help, {var:1}
escapes the cell and recovers their
belongings, then tries to flee with the
youth...
tm.謎の青年の助けにより{x:000A}牢を出て 荷物を取り返した {var:1}は:
With the mysterious youth's help, {var:1}
escapes the cell and recovers their
belongings, and the two flee through the
tunnel the youth dug to break out...
tm.自分は 勇者の生まれ変わりである。\nその事実を知った {var:1}は\n自ら:
Learning of being the Luminary reborn,
{var:1} leaves Cobblestone and reaches
the kingdom of Heliodor, only to be thrown
in the dungeon as an enemy of the land.
tm.同じく 投獄されていた 謎の青年……カミュの助けにより\n地下水路へと 脱獄を果:
With the help of a fellow prisoner, Erik,
{var:1} breaks out into the sewers and
shakes off Heliodor's soldiers and the black
dragon, but is finally cornered at the edge
of a cliff.
tm.勇者の奇跡を信じるという カミュと共に\n意を決し 崖から飛び降りた {var::
Trusting in the Luminary's luck, as Erik says
to, {var:1} leaps from the cliff. When
Erik wakes them, they're in a church on the
outskirts of Heliodor.
tm.{var:1}とカミュは 追跡するデルカダール兵から\n逃れるため 崖から飛び降:
{var:1} and Erik leapt from a cliff to
escape Heliodor's soldiers. Waking in the
Chapel of Guidance, the pair decide to take
back roads to {var:1}'s home,
Cobblestone, avoiding Hendrik.
tm.カミュは イシの村までの道案内を引き受ける代わりに\n一度 デルカダール城下町へ:
Erik agrees to guide {var:1} to
Cobblestone, in return for help recovering
something he left in Heliodor. With Erik in
the party, {var:1} visits Downtown
Heliodor.
tm.カミュの忘れ物とは レッドオーブと呼ばれる\nデルカダール王家に伝わる 秘宝のこ:
What Erik left behind is the red orb, a
treasure of Heliodor's royal family. But it's
gone from its hiding place. Suspecting his
old sidekick Derk, Erik and {var:1} go
looking for him.
tm.しかし 村に戻る前に カミュが隠したという\nレッドオーブを取り戻すこととなる。:
Before returning to the village, they must
recover the red orb Erik hid. It's not in its
hiding place, and Erik suspects his old
sidekick Derk, so {var:1} visits Erik's old
lodging house for clues.
tm.デルカダール城下町の下層にある下宿を\n切り盛りしている女将は 不在で\nデクに:
The landlady who runs the lodging house in
Downtown Heliodor is out, so there are no
leads on Derk. {var:1} and Erik split up
to look for her.
tm.城下町の下層で 下宿を切り盛りしている女将は 不在で\nデクにつながる有力な情報:
The landlady is out, so there are no leads
on Derk. The pair split up to search, and
{var:1}, keeping watch from the tower in
Downtown, spots her.
tm.下宿に戻ってきた女将に話を聞いた ふたりは\nデクが デルカダール城の近くで 店:
The landlady, now back, tells them Derk has
opened a shop near Heliodor Castle, so the
pair head up into the upper town.
tm.{var:1}とカミュは デルカダール城下町の下層に\nレッドオーブを取りにきた:
{var:1} and Erik came to Downtown
Heliodor for the red orb, but it was gone.
Suspecting Derk, they learn from the
landlady where his shop is and head up into
Heliodor.
tm.ふたりはデクを見つけ カミュは オーブの件で怒るが\nデクは ふたりを歓迎する。:
They find Derk, and Erik is furious about the
orb, but Derk welcomes them. He took the
orb to return it to Heliodor, hoping to soften
the King and save Erik from execution.
tm.かつての舎弟の気づかいに 感謝するカミュ。\nデクから 今は イシの村の先にある:
Erik thanks his old sidekick. Learning that
the orb is now kept in the Kingsbarrow
beyond Cobblestone, the pair head through
the Woodlands towards Cobblestone, as
first planned.
tm.レッドオーブが デルカダール神殿にあるという情報を\nデクから聞いた {var::
Told by Derk that the red orb is in the
Kingsbarrow, {var:1} and Erik slip out of
Heliodor past the guards. In the Woodlands,
they find a strange root.
tm.{var:1}が 根に手を触れると\n光と共に 不思議な光景が現れる。\nその光:
When {var:1} touches the root, a vision
appears in a flash of light: a monster
wrecked the bridge, turned the woodcutter
into a dog, and hid in a treasure chest.
tm.宝箱のもとへ向かった ふたりが その魔物を倒すと\n犬に姿を変えられていた木こり:
The pair defeat the monster, and the
woodcutter, human again, repairs the
bridge. The vision is said to be Yggdrasil's
guidance, a miracle seen only by the
chosen.
